additionalMarketModel: Logistic 0.01; raw signed features for first set; intercept and absolute strengths for totals. Compare Markov baseline and training/calibration-only constant. No outcome-based price backtest.
eligibility: 30 previous matches per player, source available strictly before verified kickoff minus one minute; Glicko periods are UTC days closed before forecast.
scope: Exploratory reuse of already examined historical archive, not independent validation; old 18+ prospective observations and frozen model remain unchanged. No automatic validated=true.
activation: New market needs >=500 held-out cases, lower Brier/log loss than calibration constant, ECE<0.08 and adjusted day-bootstrap upper Brier difference <0. No unsupported live or market/line mapping.
